item: 6-1613 gh2-048 #3 — 화면에 안 나오는 조각('I would have given you a ring.')이 가리키던 다른 꼴을 온전한 문장으로
add: If I had known your phone number, I would have given you a ring.
wrong: If I had known your phone number, I would have given you a gift.

item: 6-1613 gh2-048 #9 — 조각('they would have had food and clothes.')의 꼴
add: If they had had the ability to make money, they would have had food and clothes.
wrong: If they had had the ability to make money, they would have had food and cars.

item: 6-1616 gh2-049 #10 — 직접 화법 #9 의 on 을 그대로 옮긴 간접 화법
add: She said that it was a little something for me on my graduation.
wrong: She said that it was a little something for me on my birthday.
